about: IIS-only HTML cache rows (the rig's own knobs: final_view, custom_errors,
static_file, output_cache, ip_binding). Same row shape as
live-strip-chained-module-origin leaves IIS out: chaining a second module
in front of the origin needs a reverse proxy (ARR), which the rig does not have.
live-later-added-short-max-age leaves IIS out for iis-later-added-short-max-age:
IIS customHeaders cannot replace a header, so the lifetimes conflict.

rows.why: fail closed: the modules list cleared without the final-view entry
fail closed: another module replaced the response
url agreement: path info after the file
cache key: the URL as the client sent it
markdown: response header allowlist (URL Rewrite outbound rule)
markdown: response header allowlist (URL Rewrite outbound rule)
store: IIS customHeaders append to Cache-Control, a conflicting lifetime is no lifetime
purge: a site bound to a non-default port
cache key: a rewritten directory request is keyed on the URL the client sent
unkeyed header: X-Original-URL equal to the request target is stored and served
unkeyed header: X-Original-URL other than the request target is neither stored nor served
cache key: a target with a raw high byte is the client's, or nothing
